Subject: Finova trial: success criteria & sprint calendar (kickoff July 6?)

Hi Ellena / team,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — great conversation. Per our call, here's a concise post-call recap and a proposed sprint calendar so we can get the trial started with clear gates. Please review and confirm ownerships/timing so we can lock the kickoff.

Key success criteria (suggested):
- 95% intent recognition for top 10 intents on sample dataset (measured on week-2 blind set)
- End-to-end latency <= 450ms p50 for 512-token inference in your US region
- No PII leakage for masked fields in dev tests (we'll provide a data handling runbook)
- Operational readiness: go/no-go checklist passed by Finova Sec/IT

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Kickoff / onboarding: Jul 6
- Week 1: environment access + baseline tests
- Week 2: model tuning and eval sets (blind test at end of week)
- Week 3: performance tuning and canary runs
- Week 4: final readout and recommendations

Owners (Redwood):
- Technical lead / runbook: Ben Carter
- Success criteria tracking & evaluation: Marissa Cole
- Program owner: Mina Haddad (primary contact)

Requests from Finova for kickoff:
1) Confirm kickoff date (we proposed Jul 6)
2) Provide a list of stakeholders + one technical point of contact for infra access
3) Test dataset (anonymized) or a short sample with schema by EOD Jul 2 if possible

Attachment: finova-poc-template.xlsx (POC template + acceptance rubric)
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3FinovaPOC

Next steps: If Jul 6 works, Ben will schedule a 45-minute technical onboarding and we'll provision a sandbox tenant.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
